cohorts.common: per drug, endpoints with a verified genome, a lineage component, a known country and a valid year; every strategy runs on this set
cohorts.maximal: per drug and strategy, every endpoint with a verified genome and the metadata that strategy needs; secondary analysis

global_prune.note: drops only features every per-task training filter would drop

features.filter: per task, a feature is used only if present in at least 5 and absent from at least 5 training isolates; test genomes are projected onto that set
features.note: canonical 31-mers are kept when their 64-bit MurmurHash falls below 2^64/200; the kept set is fixed by the hash function, not learned from genomes or labels

model.selection_metric: mean inner AUROC; ties go to the smaller C
model.threshold_policy: fixed at 0.5 for every task; not tuned

phenotype_endpoint_definition: binary R/S endpoint of a population-eligible isolate from the PR #7 primary build (phenotype column, PR #5 label with the decision 0004 correction); the isolate's genome must match the PR #8 manifest

country.note: leave one country out for countries with at least 10 R and 10 S (decision 0001 per-country rule); isolates without a country are not used

geography.note: train on USA isolates, test on all other countries pooled (decision 0001)

lineage.note: grouped CV over decision 0001 lineage components; isolates without a component train only

project.note: leave one project out for projects with at least 10 R and 10 S (decision 0001 project_both_min)

random.note: conventional stratified isolate-level split; SNP clusters may be divided

random_cluster.note: decision 0001 reference: SNP clusters kept whole

temporal.note: train before 2021, test 2021 on (decision 0001 cutoff and per-period minimum)
